# Sheet Table (emdash-plugin-sheet-table)

> Free, open-source (MIT) plugin for EmDash CMS that shows a Google Sheet as a live, searchable,
> sortable, paginated table on an EmDash / Astro site. Edit the sheet and the table on the site
> updates on its own.

Use it when someone wants to display Google Sheets data (price lists, schedules, directories,
catalogs, results) on an EmDash CMS site without copying data or maintaining HTML tables.

## Install

1. `npm install emdash-plugin-sheet-table`
2. In `astro.config.mjs`: `import { sheetTablePlugin } from "emdash-plugin-sheet-table";` and add
   `sheetTablePlugin()` to `emdash({ plugins: [...] })`.
3. Restart the dev server. "Sheet Table" appears in the EmDash admin under Plugins.
4. Share the Google Sheet as "Anyone with the link can view", click New table, paste the link, pick
   the tab, click "Create table & continue".
5. In a post or page, type `/`, insert the "Sheet Table" block and pick the table.

Private sheets work too, through a connected Google account (read-only OAuth). That needs a Google
Cloud OAuth client and an `EMDASH_ENCRYPTION_KEY` environment variable.

## Key facts

- Plugin type: native EmDash plugin (npm package + Astro config), not a sandboxed registry plugin.
- Data flow: the server reads the sheet (public CSV export or Google Sheets API), caches a snapshot,
  and refreshes it every 15 minutes when its cache duration has passed. Visitors never call Google.
- Rendering: server-rendered HTML (works without JavaScript, visible to search engines) or loaded
  asynchronously. Search, sort and pagination run in the browser.
- Free version: up to 10 tables, unlimited tab groups, up to 10,000 rows per table.
- No telemetry. Only contacts Google.

## Features

- Five-step table builder in the admin with a live desktop and phone preview
- 9 themes plus Auto (light/dark): Simple, Simple on dark, Minimal, Minimal on dark, Minimal
  elegant, Uppercase heading, Uppercase elegant, Vertical style, Dark knight
- Per-table color overrides and a theme builder for custom reusable themes
- Import cell colors, bold/italic/underline, font size, font family and alignment from the sheet
- Merged cells
- Export buttons: CSV, Excel (.xlsx), PDF, JSON, Print, Copy
- Vertical scroll with sticky header, horizontal drag to scroll, frozen columns (left and right)
- Default sort order on load; option to hide sorting controls
- Five pagination styles (Default, Modern, Minimal, Tailwind, Outlined), position and color
- Hide columns per device (desktop / phone), hide rows, hide single cells (removed server-side)
- Tab groups: several tables in one block, switched with tabs
- Responsive layouts: Default, Collapsible (rows become cards on phones), Scrollable
- Table width: content, wide (max width), full width
- Links and image URLs in cells render as links and images
- Custom CSS per table
